title: How to Add Open to Work in Your LinkedIn Profile in 2024
description:
LinkedIn is one of the most powerful tools you can use in your job search and we highly recommend using it if you aren't already. One of its features is the ability to show on your profile that you are looking for new or different employment. 

"Bull will my current employer be able to see that I'm job searching?" This is just one of the things we'll go over along once we set our profile to "Open to work".
